title: Find distinct account IDs of female clients who are owners of their account
question: Find distinct account IDs of female clients who are owners of their accounts and have made at least one household payment ('SIPO') exceeding $5000. For these accounts, compute the unemployment rate increase percentage from 1995 to 1996 in their district, but only include districts where the average salary (A11) is above 9000.

arguments.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001
FROM account AS a
JOIN disp AS d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
JOIN client AS c ON d.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
JOIN district AS dist ON a.XCL_002 = dist.XCL_017
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
  AND d.XCL_016 = 'OWNER'
  AND dist.XCL_027 > 9000
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
      AND t.XCL_053 = 'SIPO'
      AND t.XCL_051 > 5000
  )

FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_002
  FROM client c
  JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_009 = d.XCL_014
  JOIN account a ON d.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
  JOIN trans t ON a.XCL_001 = t.XCL_047
  WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
    AND d.XCL_016 = 'OWNER'
    AND t.XCL_053 = 'SIPO'
    AND t.XCL_051 > 5000
) x
JOIN district d ON x.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
WHERE d.XCL_027 > 9000
